Balancer is a decentralized exchange protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Balancer operates as an automated market maker in which liquidity providers deposit tokens into pools. Balancer supports pools with customizable token weights. Balancer is governed through its BAL governance token.

Augur is a decentralized prediction market protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Augur uses its REP token to incentivize reporting on event outcomes. Augur resolves market outcomes through a decentralized dispute process.

Ripple is a payment network built on the XRP Ledger. Ripple uses the native XRP token for transactions. Ripple relies on a consensus protocol among validators rather than proof-of-work mining.

Gnosis.io is a prediction market platform built on the Ethereum blockchain. Gnosis.io uses conditional tokens to represent the outcomes of events. Gnosis.io was founded in 2015 by Stefan George and Martin Köppelmann.
